title: Influence of Ductility on Fracture in Tensile Testing of Cold Gas Sprayed Deposits

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: spherical shapes with only a few satellites or remaining fines. contains large grains.
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: cleaned with ethanol just before spraying

experimentalProperties.Spraying_System_Model: commercial spray system of type 5/11 from Impact Innovations (Rattenkirchen, Germany)
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: cylindrical TCT test samples were coated by setting the kinematics to a traverse gun velocity of 4 mm/s and a sample rotation speed of 200 rpm, which corresponds to a circumference speed of 250 mm/s.
